### Main Risks

- **Liver damage:** NyQuil contains acetaminophen (typically 650 mg per adult dose). Mixing alcohol with acetaminophen stresses the liver and can cause severe liver injury, especially with heavy or regular drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX1Lz8uYlUFNCVyqIG4mZqsw8nh8tX_K_Cmpop8duQDaHyIUm8QQPiejcguwoUo27PLUmLrar_qfelCXZZUKULiDZCn9t3gqva-pXjt0vkgEwp3gzSOXwbjQgtHObFNvGzrnBfXvxg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXsBan2-MFjal-9OIWJ4Im4l3jpD-RhETeKYKk6P5iR5ZhYj4MiS4gxN5iYobPqAf2CuORfwkEyH8tKW_Emr8l5ViJigMIfNy2RuEfVLtMWkWUd7I2zG38Dr5RTFUoIEOxqcbvdRAx8F8Pgfp-gpUgDt3nfg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF1wxRjZnsy6PcCJRB0Tih91dxfntWRPb3nAwwhAZD7BAtXdmjIeqgwb9Bf9NpJlr1dur-rIo6JCA9BvRgBa4IQa7marPmcx9c8efb8pWWmNtFcTWZRQosyJ2_aUbrv7poYvaP4D5H7vRcHqp-_XzAW2pnGYHZCDJ1aXfWaDHYQEqt7lw1X-J3Lv01Q9qjZ57N06r1_RM)
